title: Project Onboarding Dashboard
subtitle: PVH · AMS Team · New Joiner Guide

glossary.VDI: Virtual Desktop Infrastructure - your remote office desktop hosted on a central server, accessed via Citrix.
glossary.Citrix: A software tool that lets you securely connect to your remote VDI desktop from your laptop.
glossary.AD Groups: Active Directory Groups - permission groups that control which apps and servers you can access.
glossary.MFA: Multi-Factor Authentication - a security code from your phone's Authenticator app, proving it's really you.
glossary.BY: BlueYonder - the supply chain software platform used in this project for Demand & Supply planning.
glossary.BlueYonder: The supply chain software platform used in this project.
glossary.ServiceNow: PVH's IT ticketing portal where you raise access requests and report incidents.
glossary.JID: JDA ID - your login credential for BlueYonder Citrix applications.
glossary.DUO: A secondary MFA system used specifically for BlueYonder applications.
glossary.RITM: Request Item - a ServiceNow ticket number for access requests.
glossary.PVH Assist: The ServiceNow self-service portal for raising requests and incidents.
glossary.BeyondTrust: A privilege management tool that lets you run programs as Administrator on your Accenture laptop.
glossary.Office 365: Microsoft's cloud productivity suite - used here to activate your PVH corporate account.
glossary.Zero Touch: An automated tool in Software Center that grants temporary admin access on your Accenture laptop.
glossary.MS Teams: Microsoft Teams - the communication platform where you add your PVH account for project collaboration.

phases.title: Phase 1: PVH Account Activation
phases.desc: Activate your PVH corporate account, set up security, and change your password. This must be done first.

tasks.name: Activate PVH Account via Office 365
tasks.desc: Open an Incognito/Private browser -> search '<t>Office 365</t> login' -> go to office.com -> click Sign In -> enter your PVH email -> enter the password received in your Accenture onboarding mail -> sign in at the PVHCORP page.

tasks.name: Setup MFA for PVH
tasks.desc: After first sign-in, install Microsoft Authenticator on your phone -> click Next -> scan the QR code -> approve the notification -> click Done. Alternate: https://aka.ms/mfasetup

tasks.name: Change PVH Password Immediately
tasks.desc: Open Incognito browser -> go to https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info -> click your user icon -> select Change Password -> enter old and new password -> Submit.

tasks.name: Add PVH Account to MS Teams
tasks.desc: Open <t>MS Teams</t> -> click your profile picture -> select Add another account -> enter your PVH email and new password -> enter <t>MFA</t> code from Authenticator.

phases.title: Phase 2: Citrix & VDI Setup
phases.desc: Install Citrix Workspace, connect to the PVH remote environment, and launch your VDI desktop.

tasks.name: Install Citrix Workspace
tasks.desc: Download <t>Citrix</t> Workspace from citrix.com/downloads -> run the installer as administrator. In the <t>BeyondTrust</t> popup, select Accenture Business -> click Yes. Do not select add-ons.

tasks.name: Enable Admin Access if Needed
tasks.desc: If admin access is blocked, open Software Center -> install '<t>Zero Touch</t> Solutions - Avecto Admin Access Automation' -> restart system.

tasks.name: Configure Citrix URL
tasks.desc: Open <t>Citrix</t> Workspace -> paste URL: https://remote-na1.pvh.com. Paste the link, not your email.

tasks.name: Login to VDI
tasks.desc: Enter your PVH User ID and password in the <t>Citrix</t> login screen. Under Desktops, confirm the <t>VDI</t> option appears.

tasks.name: Complete MFA Verification
tasks.desc: Enter the 6-digit code from Microsoft Authenticator when prompted.

tasks.name: Launch & Verify VDI Desktop
tasks.desc: Verify the remote desktop loads. Always disconnect properly by clicking X at top center -> OK.

phases.title: Phase 3: Application Access Request
phases.desc: Create your BlueYonder account and set up additional security for supply chain applications.

tasks.name: BlueYonder Account Setup
tasks.desc: Go to https://success.blueyonder.com -> enter your PVH email -> click Forgot Password -> check email for reset link -> set new password.

tasks.name: Raise Citrix Access Request
tasks.desc: Raise a <t>BY</t> case in the BY Success portal to get <t>Citrix</t> access credentials. Check your email for username and password.

tasks.name: DUO / MFA Enrollment
tasks.desc: Complete <t>DUO</t> enrollment using the DUO Security email. This is a second <t>MFA</t> layer for <t>BY</t> Citrix apps.

phases.title: Phase 4: Access Validation
phases.desc: Access project applications, validate they work, and request any extra permissions needed.

tasks.name: Access Demand & Supply Citrix
tasks.desc: Login to the BY Citrix portal using your <t>JID</t> credentials. Verify each app icon opens correctly.

tasks.name: Open & Validate Applications
tasks.desc: Click each application inside Citrix, including Control-M, SQL Developer, WinSCP, and Putty, to confirm they launch without errors.

tasks.name: Raise Application Access Requests
tasks.desc: Go to <t>PVH Assist</t> -> Request Something -> Access Requests -> select app -> provide justification.

tasks.name: Get Added to AD Groups
tasks.desc: Request to be added to required <t>AD Groups</t>. Best practice is to mimic access of an existing team member.

phases.title: Phase 5: Tools & Database Access
phases.desc: Configure development tools and database connections needed for day-to-day support work.

tasks.name: Access Tools
tasks.desc: Launch SQL Developer, WinSCP, and Putty from <t>VDI</t>. Use server credentials from the access sheet.

tasks.name: Configure Database Connections
tasks.desc: Open SQL Developer -> click + -> enter host, port, username, and password -> click Test -> save if successful.

tasks.name: Validate Tool Access
tasks.desc: Test each tool connection and confirm you can connect to required servers across AMER, APAC, and EMEA.

phases.title: Phase 6: End to End Checklist
phases.desc: Perform end-to-end testing before starting project work.

tasks.name: Verify VDI + Apps + DB Access
tasks.desc: Perform a full check: <t>VDI</t> login -> open apps -> connect to databases -> confirm everything works end-to-end.

tasks.name: Perform Final Checks
tasks.desc: Verify access to BY UI links, Tivoli, PVH Remote Desktop App, and <t>ServiceNow</t> portal.

tasks.name: Disconnect VDI Properly
tasks.desc: Click the X at top-center of <t>VDI</t> screen -> click OK to disconnect. Your session continues remotely.

phases.title: Phase 7: Support & Issues
phases.desc: Know how to get help if something goes wrong during or after onboarding.

tasks.name: Raise Incident if Access Fails
tasks.desc: Go to <t>PVH Assist</t> -> Report Incident -> describe issue with screenshots -> Submit. Reference the <t>RITM</t> number if related to a request.

tasks.name: Troubleshooting Common Issues
tasks.desc: For <t>VDI</t> or password issues, use PVH Assist. For Accenture laptop admin issues, raise an Accenture Support incident.
